tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: List Phantom Pipe services, published prices, and samples. Scoped work may need a quote. The quote_request details are for direct HTTP intake; use the submit_brief tool schema for MCP inquiries.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Read a specific offer by ID from list_offers, including any published payment links. Does not open a payment link or charge anything.

tools.name: submit_brief
tools.description: Send an inquiry with the buyer’s permission. The HTTP form-name field is optional and ignored. To request the free evidence-brief sample, choose pipeline-research and explicitly ask for the three free rows in brief. Returns an intake receipt, not a signed quote; does not collect payment. Do not send

tools.name: get_quote_request_status
tools.description: Look up an intake receipt by request_id. “received” does not confirm a reply, quote issuance, or payment.

tools.name: get_quote_payment_links
tools.description: Build payment links for an already-issued signed quote token. Does not validate the token, check payment status, or initiate payment. Use only the rail specified for your quote.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_brief" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
